text: Use WASD to move.\nPress Shift to dash.
The Fragile Gauge at the bottom left\nconstantly increases during combat.\nReaching 100% results in death.
Left-click to shoot and defeat the\nmonsters.
Certain monsters do not die immediately\nand will enter a "Fragile" state.
Approach a Fragile monster and aim\nat it to display the UI.
When the UI appears, Right-click to\nteleport and execute the monster.

Defeating all monsters in the stage stops
the Fragile Gauge from rising, opening
the exit and the next pathway along
with rewards.
The Fragile Gauge is currently at a\ndangerous level.\nLet's return to safety.
This is the Lobby. From here, you can\nstart the game or upgrade your character\nto venture deeper into the Abyss.
Click on "Skill" under the Upgrade tab\nat the top.
Let's click on the first skill.

Upgrading skills requires various
resources, which can be earned as
combat rewards. Click "Upgrade" to
enhance it.
Click the "Close" button to return to\nthe Lobby and start the game.
